title.romaji: Kikansha no Mahou wa Tokubetsu desu 2nd Season
title.english: A Returner's Magic Should be Special Season 2
title.native: 帰還者の魔法は特別です 第2期

media.description:
In a land dominated by the formidable Shadow Worlds, most of humanity has been destroyed. To rescue their planet from impending doom, six brave heroes fight a perilous battle…and fail. But there’s a glimpse of hope when Desir, one of the last mages, is suddenly sent back in time 13 years! Now armed with knowledge of the grim future, can he alter the course of history and save the world?

(Source: Crunchyroll)

title.native: 転生したら剣でした 第2期

media.description:
The second season of Tensei Shitara Ken Deshita.

Note: Each episode was streamed one week in advance of the TV broadcast starting on October 1, 2026 on Abema. Regular broadcasting began on October 8, 2026.

title.native: 獣王武神ダンデヴァイン

media.description:
The story takes place 20 years after the robot Dandivine defeated the mysterious Aposdoll. The world is now in peace. However, toy manufacturer Kasuga, who relied on its toys of merchandise of Dandivine, has fallen into decline. Thus, Kasuga's president Genjuro Shijima prayed for Dandivine's revival, and the Aposdoll suddenly returned. High school student Gekiha Shijima gets an invitation from his uncle Yusaku Kuroiwa, the former main pilot of Dandivine, to pilot the giant robot himself.

(Source: Anime News Network)

title.romaji: Shin Tennis no Ouji-sama: U-17 WORLD CUP Kesshou Member Ketteisen
title.english: The Prince of Tennis II U-17 WORLD CUP: Final Member Selection Match
title.native: 新テニスの王子様 U-17 WORLD CUP 決勝メンバー決定戦

media.description:
Old rivalries reignite as Team Japan players face off to earn spots in the lineup for the World Cup final.

(Source: Crunchyroll News)

title.native: 大理寺日志 第3季

media.description: The third seasons of Dali Si Rizhi.

title.native: 魔法騎士レイアース (2026)

media.description:
Hikaru Shidou, Umi Ryuuzaki, and Fuu Hououji aren't from Cephiro. While on a school field trip to the Tokyo Tower, the three girls' minds are on anything but different worlds filled with magic and wonder. That is, until Princess Emeraude, the Pillar of Cephiro, cries out for the Magic Knights to save her world--and that just happens to be those three!

(Source: Crunchyroll)

title.native: 世界最強の魔女、始めました

media.description:
After using her SSS-Rank skill, Internet, to crush her former family’s ambitions, Lorna is free to travel the world. Her next stop is the port town of Aquas, where she hopes to see the sights and chow down on some fresh seafood. But when she arrives, the place is on the brink of destruction thanks to a certain Weekly Quest… Good thing Lorna has the gods on her side!

(Source: Crunchyroll)

title.native: 佐々木とピーちゃん シーズン２

media.description: The second season of Sasaki to Pii-chan.

title.native: ゲルぴよ 2

media.description: Second season of GelPiyo.

title.english: The Detective Is Already Dead Season 2
title.native: 探偵はもう、死んでいる。Season2

media.description:
After thwarting a hijacking with beautiful, silver-haired detective Siesta, Kimihiko leads a life of globe-trotting and crime-solving—until Siesta dies. A year later, a new case will open old wounds as it threads murder, conspiracy, and his dead partner!

(Source: Crunchyroll)

title.native: 一念永恒 第四季

media.description: The fourth and final season of Yi Nian Yongheng.

title.native: 大夏守墓人

media.description:
Ten years ago, after three consecutive days of blood moon, ghosts, gods, heterochromatic eyes, and strange tales arrived one after another. Mystery and enigma descended upon the human world. Terror and despair roamed the earth. As humans, should we kneel in submission, weep bitterly, or draw our swords? This is a new era, and this era—belongs to the extraordinary! Pushing open the door to the extraordinary, Su Bai encountered a new world…

(Source: Tencent, translated)

title.native: mofusand

media.description:
Shark Meow is an orange tabby kitty who wears a shark suit.
A little clumsy and always taking things at their own cozy pace,
but every day with their best kitty friends — and the rescued baby kitty, Little Meow —
is filled with unexpected little mishaps and sweet adventures.

A sunny warm spot in the park, the sparkle of the sea,
steam rising from freshly roasted sweet potatoes,
the fluttery feeling of the first snowfall…
These small everyday moments fill their world with warmth and delight.

You can’t help but smile and think, “So true!”
A soft and snuggly kitty anime that brings joy to everyday moments.

(Source: QTORY Channel)

title.native: ちびゴジラの逆襲 シーズン4

media.description: Sequel to Chibi Godzilla no Gyakushuu 3.

title.native: DARK MACHINE -The Animation-

media.description:
Following his grandfather’s will to “seek out the Senki,” the protagonist Kairi visits Golden Valley, a special Dark Machine economic zone. There, he meets a mysterious girl named Rudra. Dragged into becoming a Dark Machine player by Rudra, Kairi’s talent gradually blossoms over the course of many intense battles.

(Source: Fuji Creative)

Note: Part of the "DARK MACHINE" Web3 cross-media project where the story of the Game and its anime adaptation intertwine.

title.romaji: Sora wa Akai Kawa no Hotori
title.native: 天は赤い河のほとり

media.description:
After a mysterious hand drags her beneath a puddle, modern Japanese teenager Yuri awakens in the Hittite Empire of the 14th century BCE. Thrust into a deadly struggle for the throne, she joins Prince Kail to battle assassins, outwit royal conspiracies, and survive a world at war. As her exploits earn her renown as the goddess Ishtar, Yuri must choose between her old life and an uncertain future.

(Source: Crunchyroll)

title.romaji: Tsuihou Sareta Cheat Fuyo Majutsushi wa Kimama na Second Life wo Ouka Suru.: Ore wa Buki dake ja Naku, Arayuru Mono ni "Kyouka Point" wo Fuyo Dekiru shi, Ore no Ishi de Itsudemo Kouka wo Kaijo Dekiru kedo, Nokotta Hitotachi Daijoubu?
title.english: The Laid-Off Cheat-Granting Mage Enjoys a Second Lease on Life
title.native: 追放されたチート付与魔術師は気ままなセカンドライフを謳歌する。　～俺は武器だけじゃなく、あらゆるものに『強化ポイント』を付与できるし、俺の意思でいつでも効果を解除できるけど、残った人たち大丈夫？～

media.description:
Rein, an enchanter, is suddenly expelled from his guild one day. But instead of despairing, he declares, “Now I can do anything!” and begins reclaiming the massive number of enhancement points he once poured into his guildmates’ gear, setting off on a brand-new path as an adventurer.

Gathering around him are people carrying wounds that don’t fade easily: a genius adventurer who shut her heart after her party was slaughtered, a warrior who lost her family, and an assassin raised from childhood to kill. Yet Rein never rejects their pasts or their scars—he accepts them all with bright, straightforward warmth.

The stage is a unique fantasy world where Uzis, slingshots, and even yakuza exist side by side. But in this world, the more people rely on convenient technology, the more their magic weakens, and adventurers grow fragile.

Intelligent, vicious monsters roam freely, while in the underworld, outlaws bare their greed and ambition as schemes and betrayals intertwine. In a world where ideals and justice are easily crushed, adventurers fight on with nothing but their magic and their convictions.

This is the story of those who have lost their place in the world finding a new way to live. Rein and his companions’ wild, free-spirited second life begins now!

(Source: The Laid-Off Cheat-Granting Mage Enjoys a Second Lease on Life Site)

title.native: 幻想水滸伝

media.description:
Two young boys... the hero, Riliu, and his best friend Jowy, were members of a youth brigade of their home nation, the Highland Kingdom - a powerful military nation located in the north-east of the Dunan region.

The two of them looked up at the same starry skies, slept in the same tent, and believed in the same future. Once the fighting was over, and the night ended, their daily lives were sure to return.

Contrary to their hopes, the two boys become swept up in the whirlpool of fate, guided by the flames of war.

The powerless boys reached for, and grasped immense power. As the 108 stars shine brightly in the murky horizon, the boys step forward, each with their own beliefs for an answer-less question.

(Source: Official Website, translated)

Note: The first episode aired with a runtime of ~50 minutes as opposed to the standard 24 minute long episode.

title.native: 超巡！超条先輩

media.description:
The ultimate police duo is here to keep the peace! Rookie officer Nao just joined the force. She’s got a black belt in judo and earned the nickname “Gorilla” for her insane strength. Then there’s her partner Chojo, who wields every psychic power imaginable. But for a guy who can read minds, he still can’t seem to read the room. Now, these two are taking on crime together in Chinjuku.

(Source: Crunchyroll)

title.native: Battle Spirits [Re] 絶界の空

media.description:
Keio 3, Hinomoto, Eito. As the Bakumatsu throws Japan into turmoil, young Kuu Bashin dreams of becoming stronger through Standard Battle Spirits. His world changes when he encounters Ajara Zetsu, a wandering samurai and formidable Eternal Battler pursued by anti-shogunate forces. As the worlds of Standard and Eternal Battle collide, Kuu is pulled into Zetsu’s journey—and sets history in motion.

(Source: Crunchyroll)

title.romaji: Chitose-kun wa Ramune Bin no Naka Part 2
title.english: Chitose Is in the Ramune Bottle 2nd Cour
title.native: 千歳くんはラムネ瓶のなか 2クール

media.description: The second part of Chitose-kun wa Ramune Bin no Naka.

title.romaji: Shiotaiou no Satou-san ga Ore ni dake Amai
title.english: The Cold Sato-san is Only Sweet to Me
title.native: 塩対応の佐藤さんが俺にだけ甘い

media.description:
Sato-san is the unattainable flower of the class. She is always cold and curt with classmates, but only I know she's actually very cute when she smiles, even if she's not much of a photographer.

Oshio-kun is friendly and lively, but only I know he works at his family's cafe after school. He does a great job with the cafe's SNS account, and his mischievous smile makes my heart skip a beat!

Innocent and sweet, but sometimes frustrating, this is a 120%-pure fluffy story about two people falling in love for the first time.

title.native: 凶乱令嬢ニア・リストン

media.description:
A great hero lies undefeated on her deathbed, regretting that she never found a foe who could take her down. She never intended to meet her fate anywhere other than on the battlefield, and her peaceful demise has her wishing desperately that things could have been different... But when she suddenly comes to in the body of the young, frail Nia Liston, she’s got an all-new fight ahead of her. Nia is a sickly child, meaning she has a long way to go before she’s in fighting form. Now that she’s been given a second shot at life, however, she’s determined to get what she wants. She’s going to live—and die—for battle this time! Make way for the Merciless Maiden!

(Source: J-Novel Club)

title.native: 武神主宰 大威篇

media.description: The second season of Wushen Zhuzai.

title.native: 绝世战魂 第2季

media.description:
In the Canglan Continent, strength is determined by martial spirits. Qin Nan, the young master of the Qin family, was originally a useless soul, suffering endless scorn. By chance, he awakened the soul of an ancient war god, thus defying fate. He swept through sect geniuses, overcame powerful enemies and obstacles, encountered a soulmate, used his battle spirit to break all laws, and forged a legend with his blood. From a humble young master, he rose through the ranks to become an invincible supreme celestial being who shakes the nine realms.

(Source: IQIYI, translated)

title.native: 魔法少女育成計画 restart

media.description:
Some magical girls fight. Others do not. Chosen by the mysterious Land of Magic, which exists unbeknownst to the rest of the world, magical girls are each granted a unique power. Pechka, whose magic makes food delicious, is forced to take part in a mysterious virtual game together with 16 unfamiliar magical girls, each with her own distinctive personality. It was supposed to be a safe training exercise designed to improve their magical abilities. But instead, it marks the beginning of a carefully orchestrated nightmare - a forbidden trial. A new Magical Girl Raising Project has begun.

(Source: OceanVeil)

title.english: BLEACH: Thousand-Year Blood War - The Calamity
title.native: BLEACH 千年血戦篇-禍進譚-

media.description:
Destruction looms at the end of the Thousand-Year Blood War between the Soul Reapers and Quincies… as the death of the Soul King mirrors the collapse of the Three Worlds, distortions and omens of destruction start to appear in all realms.

Fierce battles erupt throughout the Wahr Welt between the Thirteen Court Guard Squads and the Royal Guard. Ichigo learns about Uryuu's true intentions and renews his determination to protect the world together, as friends who trust each other. Yhwach has surpassed even his own ability, The Almighty...

The fierce battle for the survival of the Three Worlds approaches its end. Beyond the chaos of calamity, what lies in wait—despair or hope?

(Source: VIZ Media, edited)

title.native: PSYREN -サイレン-

media.description:
One day, high schooler Ageha Yoshina picks up a mysterious “red phone card” left behind in a public telephone booth. A few days later, his childhood friend and classmate, Sakurako Amamiya—who possessed the same card—suddenly vanishes without a trace. In search of her, Ageha finds himself drawn into the rumors surrounding a nationwide string of mysterious disappearances, said to be the work of a secret organization known only as “Psyren.”

When he accesses the group, a deadly game begins—one that will change his fate forever.

(Source: PSYЯEN Official Site)

title.english: So What's Wrong with Getting Reborn as a Goblin?
title.native: 転生ゴブリンだけど質問ある？

media.description:
Office worker Akira Yagami’s altruistic nature usually gets him the short end of the stick. When he dies after saving a kid from oncoming traffic...he reincarnates in another world as a goblin?! Normally, goblins only live for seven days, but Akira’s newfound powers let him defy the species’ normal life span...and are the key to his path to becoming the strongest goblin ever!

(Source: Yen Press)

Note: Tensei Goblin Dakedo Shitsumon Aru? is streaming 1 week in advance of the TV broadcast on ABEMA and Prime Video beginning with episode 2 on October 5th, 2026

title.romaji: Doumo, Suki na Hito ni Horegusuri wo Irai Sareta Majo desu.
title.english: Hello, I am a Witch and my Crush Wants me to Make a Love Potion!
title.native: どうも、好きな人に惚れ薬を依頼された魔女です。

media.description:
“Make me a love potion.”

And with that single sentence, the Good Witch of the Lake’s secret crush on the dashing Sir Harij ends in heartbreak. Still, when he promises to help her gather the ingredients, Rose is thrilled at the chance to gaze upon a man she’d normally never get to interact with. She learns to brace her pounding heart for their usual stilted conversations…but what is she to do when he inexplicably shows up at her doorstep with bread and a jar of apple butter?

(Source: Yen Press)
